About — BAY & BROWN 0 Skip to Content Home Shop The Collection The Design School Sign up Blog About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Home Shop The Collection The Design School Sign up Blog About Contact Open Menu Close Menu Home Shop The Collection The Design School Sign up Blog About Contact Tracey Brown launched Bay & Brown in 2005 following extensive experience as a designer within the fashion textile industry. From the very beginning, we have made it our mission to create beautiful and sophisticated prints for women’s apparel, swimwear, kids and home collections and we continue to produce work that we feel proud of, with brand new designs being added into our offering every single week. Bay & Brown’s designs have become an integral part of many successful collections, in both high end and high street stores all over the world. Also providing a bespoke service to smaller brands in need of collaborative guidance. We have a dedicated sales team who love to travel to meet our customers in their design studios, as well as a team of agents globally! If you would like to set up an appointment with us to review our work please do get in touch. Sales@bayandbrown.com - The Design School by Bay and Brown offers a range of creative programs for the printed textiles world, suitable for beginners as well as working designers. With a focus on hands-on learning, expert instructors, and industry-relevant projects through digital courses and in studio workshops. The Design School equips students with knowledge and practical experience, providing customers with the tools to succeed in the fast-evolving design world. If you have any questions about our school please get in touch. design@bayandbrown.com Location Bay and Brown, Studio 22, Grow Studios, 86 B Mainyard, Wallis Rd, Hackney Wick, London E9 5LN Contact Sales@bayandbrown.com +44 (0) 2070 330 566 Terms and conditions Privacy and Cookie Policy Internship Opportunities Opportunities@bayandbrown.com +44 (0) 2070 330 566
